# M3 Expressive Paywall

> 6 ready-to-use Material 3 Expressive paywall screens for Jetpack Compose (Android). Billing-agnostic: each paywall takes a list of `PaywallPlan`s plus `onPurchase`, `onRestore` and `onClose` callbacks. Every screen shows the price, billing period, trial terms, a Restore button and Terms/Privacy links, as Google Play requires. Built on androidx.compose.material3 1.5.0-beta02, minSdk 26, MIT license.

Install: JitPack `com.github.sanikantv:m3-expressive-paywall:v1.0.0` (add `maven("https://jitpack.io")`). Requires compileSdk 37.

## Docs

- [Paywall catalog](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/docs/PAYWALL_CATALOG.md): when to use each design, signatures, Expressive APIs used, prompts
- [README](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/README.md): setup, usage, Play Billing and RevenueCat mapping, compliance checklist

## Public API (package dev.sanikant.m3.paywall)

- [PaywallModels.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/PaywallModels.kt): PaywallPlan, PaywallFeature, PaywallLegal, ComparisonRow, TrialStep, BenefitPage
- [ClassicPlansPaywall.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/ClassicPlansPaywall.kt): hero + plan cards + features
- [ComparisonPaywall.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/ComparisonPaywall.kt): Free vs Pro table
- [TrialTimelinePaywall.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/TrialTimelinePaywall.kt): Today / reminder / billing timeline
- [PlanPickerPaywall.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/PlanPickerPaywall.kt): ButtonGroup + ToggleButton + morphing card
- [LimitedOfferSheet.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/LimitedOfferSheet.kt): discount bottom sheet, countdown, LinearWavyProgressIndicator
- [OnboardingPaywall.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/OnboardingPaywall.kt): benefits pager ending in plans
- [PaywallIcons.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/PaywallIcons.kt): bundled Material icons

## Shared internals

- [internal/PaywallParts.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/internal/PaywallParts.kt): PlanCard, PlanTile, MorphRadio, ExpressiveCta, ComplianceFooter
- [internal/MorphShape.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/internal/MorphShape.kt): Morph-based Shape and rememberMorphingShape
- [internal/PaywallScaffold.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/paywall/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/internal/PaywallScaffold.kt): edge-to-edge frame with sticky bottom bar

## Optional

- [Type.kt](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/blob/main/app/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/demo/ui/theme/Type.kt): Google Sans Flex variable font as the Material 3 type scale
- [Demo app](https://github.com/sanikantv/m3-expressive-paywall/tree/main/app/src/main/java/dev/sanikant/m3/paywall/demo): MaterialExpressiveTheme with dynamic color, gallery, predictive back, fake data
